title: CellarTracker Bottle Bottle Value Leaderboard
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cellartracker:bottle bottle_value_usd=*
| stats sum(bottle_value_usd) as total_value, avg(bottle_value_usd) as avg_value by region
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks region values by total and average bottle value across CellarTracker bottle events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bottle_value_usd` values for each CellarTracker bottle event and review total and average bottle value by region.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total bottle value.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which region shows the biggest bottle value numbers in your CellarTracker bottle data.
